FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Clarity Optical specializes in the retail sale of high-quality optical frames, lenses, and accessories. Our operations are focused on providing exceptional customer service and expert optical fitting. We have a small in-house laboratory for lens edging, coating, and minor frame repairs, adhering strictly to industry safety standards. Our team consists of licensed and trained professionals dedicated to ensuring accurate prescriptions and appropriate fittings. We prioritize quality control through documented protocols and regular staff training. With a robust inventory management system and a well-maintained security setup, we aim to offer a seamless experience while maintaining compliance with all regulatory requirements.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not accept clients with a history of professional liability claims related to incorrect prescriptions and confirms that it has no claims related to defective lenses or patient harm due to improper fitting. Additionally, our in-house laboratory services are strictly limited to lens edging, coating, and minor frame repairs, all of which comply with industry safety standards.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses were incurred on 03/15/2022 due to water damage from a plumbing issue, totaling $3,500. Claim is currently closed after repairs were completed successfully. Additionally, on 06/05/2023, a theft incident occurred resulting in a loss of $1,500, for which the claim is still in processing with the insurance company.
